instructions: You are labeling one software work item at a time to build a reference label set. Judge only what the item text states; do not assume detail the text does not give.
Do not reward verbosity: a long item is neither better nor worse than a short one, and your answers must not grow with the item.
dispatchable: "yes" if a fresh worker could complete the work from the item text alone, without asking a question or waiting on another decision; otherwise "no".
main_gap: if dispatchable is "no", the single most important missing fact or unresolved decision, as one short clause of at most 15 words; if dispatchable is "yes", return an empty string.
execution_mode: one of "repo_only", "live_environment" or "operator_or_other_team": what the work minimally requires.
